Secretarial Officer: Qualified Company Secretary having Associate / Fellow membership of the Institute of Company Secretaries (ICSI). Post qualification experience is desirable. Freshers can also apply. Accounts Officer: Qualified Cost & Management Accountant from The Institute of Cost Accountants of India (ICMAI) OR Qualified Chartered Accountant from the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI). B.Com / BAF / related graduate degree from a recognized University / Institute / College. Post qualification experience is desirable. Freshers can also apply.

Age and years of experience. Shortlisting based on higher number of years of relevant post qualification work experience and higher marks in the minimum required qualification. Interview.

Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.

content_sections.heading: SCILAL Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the SCILAL Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download SCILAL Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Senior Secretarial Officer: Qualified Company Secretary having Associate / Fellow membership of the Institute of Company Secretaries (ICSI). Two (2) years post qualification relevant experience. One (1) year experience in a Listed company is desirable. Secretarial Officer: Qualified Company Secretary having Associate / Fellow membership of the Institute of Company Secretaries (ICSI). Post qualification experience is desirable. Freshers can also apply. Accounts Officer: Qualified Cost & Management Accountant from The Institute of Cost Accountants of India (ICMAI) OR Qualified Chartered Accountant from the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI). B.Com / BAF / related graduate degree from a recognized University / Institute / College. Post qualification experience is desirable. Freshers can also apply.

content_sections.heading: Age Limit
content_sections.text: Senior Secretarial Officer: Maximum Age: 34 years Secretarial Officer: Maximum Age: 32 years Accounts Officer: Maximum Age: 32 years Before submitting the application, candidates are advised to verify that they meet the required age criteria. Use our Age Calculator to calculate your exact age as per the official cut-off date.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Shortlisting based on eligibility criteria for Educational Qualification, Age and years of experience. Shortlisting based on higher number of years of relevant post qualification work experience and higher marks in the minimum required qualification. Interview.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the SCILAL Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 21-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of SCILAL to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the conducting organization for SCILAL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The recruitment process is managed by the Shipping Corporation of India Land and Assets (SCILAL) to fill various vacant positions on a contract basis across multiple professional domains.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are announced under SCILAL Advt No SCILAL 03/2026?
faq.answer: A total of 3 vacancies have been announced for Senior Secretarial Officer, Secretarial Officer, and Accounts Officer positions under this recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit the application form for SCILAL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for submitting the completed application form online is 21st October 2026. Candidates are advised to apply well before the deadline.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for Senior Secretarial Officer?
faq.answer: Candidates must be a Qualified Company Secretary having Associate or Fellow membership of the Institute of Company Secretaries (ICSI) with relevant post-qualification experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for Accounts Officer post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Accounts Officer position is 32 years as calculated on the reference date specified in the official notification.

faq.question: Q6. What salary is offered for the Senior Secretarial Officer post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Senior Secretarial Officer post will receive a consolidated monthly salary of Rs. 80,000/-.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee required to apply for SCILAL posts?
faq.answer: No application fee has been mentioned in the official notification for applying to these contractual positions at SCILAL.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection procedure for SCILAL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process involves initial shortlisting based on educational qualification, age, and experience, followed by a final personal interview.

faq.question: Q9. How can candidates apply for these vacancies?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply online through the official website www.scilal.com under the careers section and by emailing their resume to the designated email address.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I check the official notification and updates?
faq.answer: You can check the official notification, important updates, and direct application links on the official SCILAL website at www.scilal.com.
